notes: David's spice order arrives in batches. Day 1 the box is empty. From day 2, two jars arrive at a time, at random intervals of 2 to 10 hours. Fills toward 16 in the box and never exceeds it. Revised 29 October; times_per_day and every_n_days are placeholders until the interval columns exist.
Bottles keep turning up. Eight a day from day 1, each at its own random time, each in a randomly chosen room or container. Admin-configurable.

Two a day from day 1, same scatter rule as the bottles. Drop 3 rather than 30 because they have been arriving since the scheduler shipped without reading this column, and the call was to keep them rather than take them away - so the row sits on the drop the beta server is actually on.

The toy channel row. Fill toward max_present, never exceed; the cap is scoped to type = toy, not to a thing_id, so a thirteenth toy is a row rather than an engine change. Six a day from 25 October 2026, up from four, because the channel now starts empty at drop 2 rather than with two toys already in it.

The toy house row, drop 46. Toys stop arriving on the road and start turning up anywhere in the house - any room's floor or any container in it, every spot equally likely, with no weight column. A toy that lands loose on a floor is announced with channel.arrival, the line the road has always used; one that lands inside something is not, because that one is meant to be found. Supersedes row 4 rather than joining it: two rows drawing from the same selector are not two schedules, and the arrived row with the higher since_drop is the one that runs. max_present 6 is the seed for toys_present, which now counts every takeable toy on a floor or in a container anywhere in the house, the trash can excepted.
